query: Who was the most recent woman to become President of Peru?

results.title: Keiko Fujimori - Wikipedia
results.content:
President of Peru since 2026
Fujimori is the second woman to become president of Peru, after Dina Boluarte, and the first to be elected in her own right.
Fujimori was inaugurated on 28 July 2026 in Lima.
She became Peru's 9th president since late 2016 and the country’s first female elected president.
